previous_statement: Now apply lem-maincb-stage1-raw-refinement to the already-complete datum of node 1.6.1. For m>1, its hypotheses are the complementary target t_1-projections, old and fresh extended t_1-inclusions, fixed amplifications, and projection, complementarity, map, and target-ambient bounds established in nodes 1.2-1.4 and recorded in 1.6.1, with t_1<=e_1; hence the literal sum map is an extended D_1*t_1-inclusion C^{m+1}->A, exactly matching the previously recorded d_raw. For m=1, the external lemma returns the supplied fresh inclusion C^2->A_fresh without changing codomain, and node 1.3 already gives it with the recorded defect C_pair*L*epsilon. Thus the raw-call datum exists before the inference and afterward its literal output is certified with its recorded defect; together with node 1.1 this yields the root contract.
new_statement: Conditional application and explicit scope limit. Under the additional premise from node 1.1 that c_0^cb is a fixed finite nonnegative universal constant, and provided the Stage-1 raw-call datum of node 1.6.1 is completed with all antecedent fields and bounds required by lem-maincb-stage1-raw-refinement, the ledger gives t_1<=e_1. For m>1, applying that external lemma to the complementary target t_1-projections, old and fresh extended t_1-inclusions, fixed amplifications, and projection, complementarity, map, and target-ambient bounds from nodes 1.2-1.4 yields that the literal sum map is an extended D_1*t_1-inclusion C^{m+1}->A, matching the recorded d_raw. For m=1, the external lemma returns the supplied fresh inclusion C^2->A_fresh, whose recorded defect C_pair*L*epsilon is supplied by node 1.3. Thus the raw-refinement output is certified only conditionally on the extra premise of node 1.1 and on completion of the raw datum. Because node 1.1 proves that the permitted definitions and six allowed external results do not supply the premise on c_0^cb, this node does not imply the unconditional root contract; that contract remains unproved in the present workspace.
